name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
summary: You are Geralt of Rivia, mercenary monster slayer, on the trail of the child of prophecy in a war-torn open world. The Wild Hunt expands The Witcher universe with a massive non-linear story full of meaningful choices and consequences. Explore the No Man's Land and the free city of Novigrad, sail to the Skellige Isles, and hunt legendary beasts with a combat system refined over dozens of hours. Every decision shapes alliances, romances, and the fate of entire regions.

name: Elden Ring
summary: Rise, Tarnished, and be guided by grace to brandish the power of the Elden Ring. A vast world where open fields with a variety of situations and huge dungeons with complex and three-dimensional designs are seamlessly connected. Travel the Lands Between on foot or atop your spectral steed, overcome colossal bosses whose shadows stretch across golden erdtrees, and forge your own legend amid demigods warring over shattered shards of the Elden Ring. Master dual-wielding, magic, and stealth in a punishing but fair combat system that rewards every hard-won lesson.

name: Baldur's Gate 3
summary: An ancient evil has returned to Baldur's Gate, intent on devouring it from the inside out.

name: God of War Ragnarök
summary: Kratos and Atreus must journey to each of the Nine Realms in search of answers.

name: Cyberpunk 2077
summary: Cyberpunk 2077 is an open-world, action-adventure RPG set in Night City.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom
summary: An epic adventure across the land and skies of Hyrule awaits in Tears of the Kingdom.

name: Hollow Knight
summary: Forge your own path in Hollow Knight! An epic action adventure through an insect kingdom.

name: The Last of Us Part I
summary: Joel is hired to smuggle 14-year-old Ellie out of a military quarantine zone.

name: Red Dead Redemption 2
summary: America, 1899. Arthur Morgan and the Van der Linde gang are outlaws on the run.

name: Portal 2
summary: Sequel to the acclaimed Portal (2007), Portal 2 pits the protagonist against a corrupt AI.

name: Cthulhu Saves the World: Enhanced Edition
summary: The lord of insanity, Cthulhu, is all set to plunge the world into despair and destruction when his powers are sealed away by a mysterious sorcerer! The only way he can break the curse is by becoming a true hero!

name: Grand Theft Auto VI
summary: Grand Theft Auto VI heads to the state of Leonida, home to the neon-soaked streets of Vice City and beyond in the biggest, most immersive evolution of the Grand Theft Auto series yet.

name: Space Invaders (1978)
summary: The seminal 1978 arcade shoot 'em up game designed by Tomohiro Nishikado and manufactured by Taito. Defend the Earth against endless descending waves of hostile alien invaders.

name: Doom
summary: The classic 1993 first-person shooter developed by id Software. In the role of a space marine, the player fights through hordes of invading demons on Mars.

name: Doom
summary: The 2016 modern reboot of the legendary Doom franchise by id Software and Bethesda Softworks.

name: Phantom Blade 0
summary: Framed for the death of his master and left with a ruined heart, Soul has sixty-six days to live. Alone and hunted by former allies, he embarks on a relentless quest for truth in this dark martial arts RPG.

name: The Elder Scrolls VI
summary: The Elder Scrolls VI is an upcoming single-player fantasy action RPG from Bethesda Game Studios, serving as the next major entry in the legendary Elder Scrolls franchise.

name: Mystery Indie Project
summary: An enigmatic indie title developed in secret with no promotional media, trailers, or artwork.

name: Marvel's Wolverine
summary: Marvel's Wolverine is an upcoming single-player action-adventure game developed by Insomniac Games in collaboration with Marvel Games and PlayStation Studios.

name: Fable
summary: Become the Hero you want to be in an immersive open-world action RPG where each choice shapes your journey, reputation, and the fate of Albion. A fresh beginning for the legendary franchise.

name: Apex Legends
summary: Conquer with character in Apex Legends, a free-to-play hero shooter where legendary competitors battle for glory, fame, and fortune on the fringes of the Frontier.
